title: Travis Walton was dead and revived
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Travis Walton was dead and revived, about 1975 at Arizona, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: In Dr. in um Travis Walton's case, Dr. Leer thinks he or he was dead and they brought him back to life.

plain: A man named Steve Coburn, speaking on podcast host Jesse Michels's show, passes on the view of a doctor named Roger Leer about Travis Walton, the man at the center of a 1975 encounter case in Arizona. According to Coburn, Leer thinks Walton actually died and was brought back to life by whoever had him. If true, it would make Walton's experience far more extreme than a simple sighting.
